entry.title: ‘Kept you waiting, huh?’ Not really, but Solid Snake is sneaking into Rainbow Six soon, for some reason
entry.summary:
I haven't played Rainbow Six Siege in quite some time, but I may have to, considering an all-time gaming icon is set to join the roster.
An official collab between Ubisoft and Konami will bring Metal Gear Solid's Solid Snake into the fold as a playable operator in Rainbow Six Siege for season one of year 11. And I'm very happy about this, because it's Solid Snake and not Big Boss, for once.
In the teaser trailer for the new operator, Splinter Cell's Sam Fisher (already in the game as a character named Zero) contacts Snake on his Codec, iconic sound effects and all. So yeah, this is legit, even if I'm not a player of the game.
My personal experience with R6 Siege is minimal. I played it for a very short time on PS4 many years ago. I also had no idea that Sam Fisher was in the game, or that there were "guest" characters like this a tall, but it's hard not to get excited, especially for Snake.
This mark's just one of several recent MGS collabs in recent years, including Solid Snake and Raiden appearing in Fortnite back in 2024, and Delta Force featuring the iconic David Hayter as the voice for Naked Snake as an appearance option for an existing character.
Solid Snake being back in the spotlight in this way also does make me feel like Konami may be cooking something up for MGS1. The game's 30th anniversary is coming in two years, and I'd say it's highly probable that we could see a remake in the same vein as last year's Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater.
Ubisoft says the full reveal of Solid Snake is coming in a few weeks on Feb. 15, so I will be tuned in to see what it's all about. If Snake's character kit doesn't include some kind of cardboard box, I will be none too pleased.

entry.title: Quickest way to get all FC 26 Season 5 Silver Icons
entry.summary:
FC 26 Season 5 brings a host of new Silver Icons to obtain in Ultimate Team, and using a well-optimized team will save plenty of time.
Every Silver Icon has two tasks, and you have to complete either one to unlock the card. With so many Silver Icons on offer, it will take a lot of time if you try to get them all. Thankfully, using a strategic lineup will reduce the effort on your end.
Best squad to get FC 26 Season 5 Silver Icons
To quicken the process, you'll want to play in Squad Battles (min. Professional difficulty) and have the following in your squad.
Six Premier League players in your starting eleven
One French player in the starting eleven. You should put him as a forward.
Building the correct squad is only a part of the grind. Here's what you'll need to complete to earn all the Icons on offer.
Assist with a through ball with a French player (in 50 games)
Win the game (40 games)
Score a goal with a chip shot with a French player (in 40 games)
Score a goal from outside the box (in 30 games)
Concede less than one goal (in 25 games)
Score with a CB (in 15 games)
Scoring with a chip shot is the hardest of all the tasks. If you want to take an alternate strategy, I will recommend using a French striker in Division Rivals and Champions. When you're playing against other players, there will be situations when you'll be through on goal. It's easy to score with a chip shot when your opponent is rushing their goalkeeper out.
The rest of the tasks can be completed in either PvP (Live events, Rivals, etc.) or against the AI (Squad Battles).

entry.title: Court Orders Porkbun and Other Registrars to Hand Over PornXP Domains to Aylo
entry.summary: Pornhub parent company Aylo has won its copyright infringement lawsuit against PornXP, securing a $10.2 million damages award against its Kyrgyzstani operator. The court also ordered domain registries to disable and transfer the PornXP domains to Aylo. However, since domain registrars are not mentioned in the court order, PorkBun refused to take action, which meant that Aylo had to go back to court. From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

entry.title: Disney, Netflix & Crunchyroll Try to Take Pirate Sites Down Globally Through Indian Court
entry.summary: The High Court in New Delhi, India, has granted another pirate site blocking order in favor of American movie industry giants, including Apple, Warner., Netflix, Disney and Crunchyroll. The injunction targets notorious pirate sites, requesting blockades at Indian ISPs. More crucially, however, globally operating domain registrars, including U.S. companies, are also compelled to take action. However, despite earlier cooperation, most don't seem eager to comply. entry.title: X Sues Music Publishers Over “Weaponized” DMCA Takedown Conspiracy
entry.summary: Elon Musk's X Corp. filed a landmark antitrust complaint against the NMPA, Sony, Universal, and other major music publishers, claiming that they used a coordinated "extortionate campaign" to force licensing deals. The lawsuit alleges that a flood of "baseless" DMCA notices targeted over 200,000 posts and suspended 50,000 users, allegedly to coerce X to sign industry-wide agreements. entry.title: Italy Fines Cloudflare €14 Million for Refusing to Block Pirate Sites on Public 1.1.1.1 DNS (Update)
entry.summary: Italy’s communications regulator AGCOM imposed a record-breaking €14.2 million fine on Cloudflare after the company failed to implement the required piracy blocking measures. Cloudflare argued that filtering its global 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver would be "impossible" without hurting overall performance. AGCOM disagreed, noting that Cloudflare is not necessarily a neutral intermediary either. From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

entry.title: French Court Orders Google DNS to Block Pirate Sites, Dismisses ‘Cloudflare-First’ Defense
entry.summary: The Paris Judicial Court has ordered Google to block nineteen additional pirate site domains through its public DNS resolver. The blockade was requested by Canal+ and aims to stop pirate streams of Champions League games. In its defense, Google argued that rightsholders should target intermediaries higher up the chain first, such as Cloudflare's CDN, but the court rejected that. Dnes se krátce vrátíme časem do dávných dob. Totiž do roku 1984, kdy měl premiéru film This is Spinal Tap. Byl to unikátní film, spousta z vás o něm možná nikdy neslyšela, a je pár důvodů, proč se o něm rozepsat právě teď. Ale popořádku... Film This is Spinal Tap je rockový hudební dokument (neboli "rockument") o britské kapele Spinal Tap (přesněji "Spin̈al Tap", ale nechce se mi to písmeno pořád hledat), která vznikla v 60. letech, prošla několika zásadními změnami image a dnes (tj. v 80. letech) už moc nefrčí a snaží se o comeback. Jejich fanoušek, režisér Marty DiBergi, se rozhodl natočit o jejich historii i současných strastech celovečerní dokument, který nám nabídne pohledy do zákulisí, intimní výpovědi, osudové zvraty a spoustu hudby.
